data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 names the relation as abstraction ("direct product is a quotient of the complement construction by the PIE symmetry group"), but the covering principle it actually establishes is dependence/reduction of 648 on PIE structure, not a genuine quotient abstraction. The stated refutation condition is incoherent with the claimed relation kind: it asks whether the direct product can be recovered from the complement construction 'without eliminating the PIE correction step', yet a quotient-by-symmetry abstraction necessarily eliminates exactly that correction step — so the refuter would merely confirm the abstraction rather than refute it. The target thus asserts an abstraction relation whose refutation-if clause does not test abstraction at all, leaving the substantive relation to SRC_003/SRC_001 ungrounded.
